newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Harsco sets 3 Bln Bfr CP programme via BBL.
newsitem.headline: Harsco sets 3 Bln Bfr CP programme via BBL.

text.p: Diversified U.S. manufacturing and services company Harsco Corp. on Wednesday set a three billion Belgian franc equivalent multi-currency commercial paper programme which it said would replace some of the group's U.S. dollar denominated debt.

Harsco Vice-President and Treasurer Barry Sullivan told a presentation in Brussels the Belgian franc CP programme, arranged and to be lead managed by Banque Bruxelles Lambert, would partly replace the group's outstanding $100.6 million U.S. CP programme.
"Seventy percent has already been transferred in the form of bridging loans with BBL," Sullivan said.
In a prospectus, the issuer was named as Harsco's Dutch registered subsidiary Harsco Europa BV.
The paper can be issued in Belgian francs, any other Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) currency, or Ecus.

The issue price will be determined at the time of issue. CPs with a maturity up to one year will be discounted on a zero coupon basis. Those over one year will be issued on a fixed or floating rate basis, according to the prospectus.
